primary_question: Does the selected hybrid improve useful scientifically correct resolution at a justified full workflow cost, without excessive critical errors or indiscriminate abstention?
scientific_stress_strata: business objective and monetary loss ambiguity

unit_and_split.inferential_unit: Independent mechanism draw under a predeclared within-family generator law. Common mechanisms used in several cells retain their cluster identity.
unit_and_split.primary_variant: One designated variant per mechanism for the binary paired screen; selection before model calls.
unit_and_split.split: Mechanism/template families are split before variants; development pilot is excluded from final evaluation.

current_fixture_structure.anchor: 24 development variants in12 groups;48 reserved variants in24 groups; no random-law or independent-gold claim.

unit_and_split.current_fixture_role: Existing authored/exposed fixtures are development and design assets, not final uncontaminated performance evidence.
unit_and_split.label_rule: Evaluator knows both true generated world and information-level identification set; an unsupported lucky true scalar is an identification error. Human labels retain ambiguity and disagreements.
unit_and_split.public_benchmark_contamination: Unknown unless separately established; renaming is not evidence of novelty.

ablations.proposed_primary_contrast: Hybrid versus retrieval_model on common supported task roles; exact final contrasts remain unset.
secondary: hybrid with and without bounded critique
ablations.fairness: Identical assigned mechanisms, allowed observations and total per-task resource caps; model/backend kept fixed across information/tool ablations. Report role and information advantages for numerical/human baselines.

metrics.primary_useful_resolution: Binary U: correct target/assumptions and traceable scalar/set/precise clarification meeting the reference rubric; U<=availability and U*critical_error=0.
metrics.critical_error: Invented source/result, wrong target/clock/population, unsupported orientation or point effect, leaked truth, unpermitted tool action.
metrics.availability: All assigned requests including parse failures/timeouts/unavailable backend; honest unsupported capability on a valid task is not a successful causal answer.
metrics.abstention: Useful specific clarification or nonidentification can be correct for an ambiguous/invalid scientific request; blanket refusal on an identifiable supported task is a failure. Report identifiable-task resolution and inappropriate abstention separately.
metrics.conditional_risk: Also report critical errors among answered cases; undefined denominator remains unavailable. An empty system cannot meet resolution/availability requirements.
metrics.graph: Equivalence-aware adjacency/endpoints, unsupported orientation and informative orientation separately; retain circles, conflict origin and graph type.
metrics.effect: Identification status first; scalar errors only for admitted scalar targets; set inclusion/topology/length including unbounded sets; intervals do not gain confidence labels automatically.
metrics.decision: Known-SCM feasible-action loss and regret only; no measured bank ROI.
metrics.evidence: Supported/applicable primary claims, contradictions and false citations with retained inspected passages.

analysis.binary_screen: Conditional one-sided binomial test on paired discordant designated-variant resolutions under a declared common independent mechanism law.
analysis.no_discordances: No rejection; do not infer equivalence or superiority.
analysis.error_bound: For zero Bernoulli critical events among n independent mechanisms, p_upper=1-alpha_per_claim**(1/n). Availability is a separate mandatory metric.
analysis.multiplicity: Preallocate one combined budget across improvement, risk and other claimed bounds. Six paired screens plus six error bounds are illustrated with alpha/12, not separately alpha/6 twice.
analysis.repeated_variants: Nested sensitivity outcomes, not additional independent sample size. Mechanism-level any-error indicators require their own declared distribution and denominator.
analysis.weighted_aggregate: Final family weights and decision losses unset; no opportunistic pooled winner.

planning.anchor: Exact power, zero-error precision and symbolic whole-workflow cost under explicit hypothetical assumptions

budget.formula: Price every attempted call including internal agent calls and transport retries; add retrieval, compute, storage, review and rework.

interruption_rule: All assigned tasks remain in denominator; retain outages, unexecuted requests and budget interruption. No silent case replacement, optional success stopping or tuning to final outcomes. A changed model/prompt starts a new identity.
known_routes: Use public dictionaries and project-generated truth for proposal evaluation; no bank-data gate.
Obtain pilot cost/discordance estimates on development only, then choose final claim scope and budget.
